answer: Yes. Activating **CBL** and **CNN1** together does more than the two genes add up to (class: more than additive). 1. The response of the pair is 1.45 times the sum of the two single responses. 2. 113 genes deviate from the sum at an FDR of 5 %; the haemoglobin genes are amplified: - HBZ (interaction z 50.1) - HBA2 (interaction z 58.4) This is an activation experiment, not a knock-down.
